title: koeleria cristata var. brevifolia
intro: Koeleria cristata var. brevifolia, commonly known as Small Hair Grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae). It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, skin conditions, and wounds, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria cristata var. brevifolia include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin, as well as reduce inflammation and fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
